name: Pine Lake RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.5298,-85.3953: gravel loops of RV sites east of US-231; a long pond lies ~200 m SE of the rows behind pines, not at any site - not waterfront

name: North Florida Fair RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1 km frame) at 30.4025,-84.2778: open grass rows on the fairgrounds south of the exhibit barns; a stormwater pond lies across the rail line to the SW, not at the sites - not waterfront

name: Wewa RV Park and Trading Post
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.1462,-85.2117: gravel loop west of FL-71; the Chipola/Dead Lakes cypress swamp lies ~150 m west beyond a tree band, no open water at the sites - not waterfront

name: Pellicer Creek Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 29.6535,-81.2878: sites under dense live-oak canopy beside US-1; Pellicer Creek winds ~100 m west and south behind forest, not visible from any pad - not waterfront (defaults down under canopy)

name: Panhandle RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m frame) at 30.4365,-85.3423: compact gravel loops south of FL-20 in cleared pine flatwoods; two small ponds sit off the loop edges, not at the rows - not waterfront
